title: agent_membership_change notification: E2EE preview MUST be client-redacted

preconditions.comment: Source Flow is E2EE; bridge synthesises an agent_membership_change notification for client-side display. notification_type is a private-object notification, NOT a reducer Event kind.

input_notification.preview_intentionally_omitted: notification.schema.json types preview as object (not nullable); E2EE bridges OMIT preview entirely rather than sending null. Client MAY compute a local preview after MLS unwrap.

expected_delivery_invariants: bridge SHALL NOT attach plaintext preview from MLS-protected Move
preview field is absent OR an opaque ciphertext object (notification.schema.json types preview as object; MUST NOT be null)
receiver client computes preview locally after MLS unwrap if needed

negative_sub_case.remediation: operator MUST patch bridge; affected notifications SHOULD be quarantined

design_note: Privacy invariant in §14: server-side bridge is not inside the MLS ratchet, so it has no plaintext to leak; if it appears to have plaintext, the deployment is mis-configured. This fixture is delivery-time invariant; no reducer Event is involved (the underlying source-Realm membership change rides on standard cx.member.state / cx.capability.{grant,revoke} kinds).
